procedure: Extract source-only release ZIP into a different directory
Run unpacked setup into its own .venv
Start unpacked application on an unused loopback port with an empty database
Bootstrap a new account, create a project and load synthetic examples
Queue review, poll durable worker and download verified JSON report

results.scope: Unpacked source ZIP; its own freshly installed .venv and empty database; real HTTP and durable worker. macOS only.

later_changes: Documentation, static-check script, package exclusions and launcher line-ending metadata only; one whitespace-only line removed from web/app.js. Runtime behavior unchanged.
privacy: No source account, uploaded project data, database or model weights copied into source package.
